_comment: Tier-2 for febio::growth_remodeling#0 — four failures from one claim, each at a different stage. Deleting <growth> or <elastic> is caught at read time and each is named; an uncoupled Mooney-Rivlin elastic child reads SUCCESS and then gives 'Elastic material should not be of type uncoupled' + 'Model initialization failed'; an unregistered type gives 'tag "material" (line N) : invalid value for attribute "type"'; and wrapping the material in a `solid mixture` reads SUCCESS and then dies at the first increment. That last branch FALSIFIES the claim's Signal: it does NOT report 'N negative jacobians detected.'. It reports 'Max nr of iterations reached.', then '------- failed to converge at time', 0 completed steps and error termination. The fixture asserts the negative-jacobian string is ABSENT, so the wrong Signal cannot come back. All four branches required. Positive control: the shipped template, unmodified, which reaches normal termination. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF).
